newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mackay files action against CSR.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mackay files action against CSR.

text.p: Mackay Refined Sugars Pty Ltd said on Monday it has begun legal action in New Zealand against CSR Ltd subsidiary New Zealand Sugar Corp seeking about NZ$10 million damages.
Athol Harley, a director of Mackay, said the actions chiefly allege that the CSR unit intended to eliminate Mackay as a competitor by wielding its price-cutting power in the market.
"This action is about the industrial sugar market," Harley told Reuters. He said the allegations in part refer to long-term contracts entered into by CSR and sugar buyers.
A CSR spokesman declined to comment on the allegations, saying he was not aware of the legal proceedings.
Mackay is a joint venture between international commodities firm E.D.& F Man and the Mackay Sugar Co-operative.
The action is separate from legal actions lodged in December 1994 by Mackay against CSR in Australia valued by Mackay at a minimum of A$60 million, Harley said.
In the face of CSR's pricing policy, Mackay had only been able to establish its position in the Australia and New Zealand markets by incurring significant losses, Harley said.
The case in Australia should go to trial mid-April, he said.
